title: Turkey and root vegetable tray
summary: Turkey and root vegetable tray is a british dinner built around turkey breast steaks and parsnips, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Heat the fan oven to 200°C. Cut the vegetables for Turkey and root vegetable tray into even pieces and toss parsnips with a teaspoon of the oil and a pinch of salt in the tin.
steps.tip: Even pieces cook at the same rate, so nothing is burnt while something else is still raw.

steps.instruction: Roast that first tray of parsnips while you season turkey breast steaks. Pat it dry so the surface browns instead of steaming.
Nestle turkey breast steaks and carrots among the vegetables. Roast until the protein is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
steps.tip: Taste Turkey and root vegetable tray before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Rest the tin for a few minutes, taste, and spoon Turkey and root vegetable tray into warm bowls with the juices.
